sections.body: How much life insurance do you need?. Rules of thumb: 10–12x income, plus debts, minus assets; a needs analysis beats any rule.

sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Start with the DIME method: Debts, Income replacement (years × income), Mortgage, Education. Subtract liquid assets. Then sanity-check affordability — the best policy is one you keep paying. Revisit after marriages, births, and mortgages. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.

record_text:
Key points.
How much life insurance do you need?. Rules of thumb: 10–12x income, plus debts, minus assets; a needs analysis beats any rule.

In depth.
Start with the DIME method: Debts, Income replacement (years × income), Mortgage, Education. Subtract liquid assets. Then sanity-check affordability — the best policy is one you keep paying. Revisit after marriages, births, and mortgages. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
source_note: Sourced: standard insurance knowledge; educational only, not financial advice.
